name: Lentils with Cauliflower, Carrots, Caper-Anchovy Salsa Verde & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
6 medium carrots
3 small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Separate each cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Divide between two large baking sheet pans.
Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots. Add to the baking sheets with the cauliflower.

Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the baking sheets along with whole (unpeeled) garlic cloves. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium red onions
6 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until the veggies are golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a large pot. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cups green lentils, dried
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the lentils are cooking, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Mince anchovy fillets and capers. Add both to the bowl with the parsley along with additional oil, vinegar, and pepper; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 anchovy fillets, packed in oil
3 tbsp capers
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the lentils are done, drain and return to the pot. Cover and set aside.

When the veggies are done, carefully transfer roasted garlic to the cutting board. Using the back of a spoon, press on the cloves to remove the skins. Mash with a fork, add to the bowl with the parsley mixture, and stir to combine the salsa verde.
Add half of the salsa verde to the pot with the lentils. Stir to combine. (Reserve remaining salsa verde for serving.)
To serve, divide lentils between plates or bowls; top with the veggies, feta, and reserved salsa verde. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
